body:
Hey @eddyparkinson , I am Alex, developer working on the Shopify Project. @Haroenv is right, we are using instant search v1 which is not supported any more. We have a conversation going on about this topic for Shopify, but this has not be defined as a goal for the following weeks / months at least. That having said, thanks for the heads up, we have more and more requests about this topic and this is exactly this type of initiative that will make us want to choose to update for IS2. Please reach out our support if you have technical question about Shopify.

cc @wittydeveloper
